ABOUT
02
ABOUT
MEDIA STUDENT CONTENT CREATOR VIDEO & EDITING ADVERTISING MARKETING & SOCIAL

I study Mass Communication, majoring in Film Production, at Symbiosis Centre for Media and Communication, Pune.

I make things for a living I haven't fully started yet — video, edits, campaign ideas, the occasional caption that takes longer than the shoot did. I like that this field lets me try on different roles: writer one week, editor the next, marketer after that. I've interned inside an agency, built and led a marketing team from scratch, and put out a personal reel that reached 9.3 million people who have no idea who I am. Most of what I know, I've picked up by doing it badly first. I'm still figuring a lot of this out, and I like it that way.

MARKETING HEAD — MAY–DEC 2025

Soch Et
Latte.

A new co-working café whose biggest problem had nothing to do with food — it was that people couldn't find it.

The Problem

A café in a location invisible to everyday passersby.

The Challenge

Get people to discover and choose a place they'd never walk past.

The Approach

Position around the real value — flexible co-working — through content and visibility.

The Team

Built and led a 10-person marketing team.

The Outcome

Helped the café reach break-even.

PLAY
06
SPORTS & LEADERSHIP

Off the timeline.

Captain, girls' cricket.

Almost no participation in girls' cricket on campus — beginners lacked confidence, past attempts had fallen through, no coach. As captain I worked on motivating first-timers and kept practice consistent until we had a squad committed enough to represent our college for the first time against Symbiosis institutes from across India.

We didn't win. But the barrier broke, and the team carried on into the following year.
